visual_patterns.visual_hierarchy: Large product render first, oversized short headline second, then proof labels and conditions.

visual_patterns.image_text_ratio: About 55:45 in technical units; lifestyle unit shifts toward image.
visual_patterns.whitespace: Limited inside proof panels; greater in the main image and lifestyle break.
visual_patterns.full_bleed_usage: Frequent dark full-bleed fields in both gallery and A+.
visual_patterns.card_usage: Proof cards and A+ navigation cards organize dense specifications.
visual_patterns.product_scale: Usually large or dominant; small only in comparison.
visual_patterns.typography_hierarchy: Large white headline, medium proof title, small conditions; hierarchy is clear but lower tiers can become tiny.
visual_patterns.dark_light_rhythm: Predominantly dark; comparison and FAQ create the late light break.
visual_patterns.scene_technical_rhythm: Several technical units, one lifestyle pause, then utility and confidence.
